description: Every Ignopticon dataset, labelled for serving. Validate with scripts/catalog_check.py. Formats are detailed in docs/DATASETS.md.

tiers.public-static: payloads the UI loads; serve from object storage + CDN

tiers.raw-archive: downloaded or intermediate files, rebuildable, never served
